name: bedrock

subcommands.name: batch-delete-evaluation-job

subcommands.name: create-advanced-prompt-optimization-job

subcommands.description: Creates a test for an Automated Reasoning policy.

subcommands.name: create-automated-reasoning-policy-version

subcommands.description: Creates an application inference profile to track metrics and costs when invoking a model.

subcommands.name: create-marketplace-model-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an endpoint for a model from Amazon Bedrock Marketplace.

subcommands.name: create-model-copy-job
subcommands.description: Copies a model to another region so that it can be used there.

subcommands.name: create-model-customization-job

subcommands.name: create-provisioned-model-throughput
subcommands.description: Creates dedicated throughput for a base or custom model with the model units and for the duration that you specify.
